scientific_purpose: Bounded falsification of whether the configured DSH system provides operational value over the real native baseline on the frozen historical OC-B task without violating correctness, intervention, provenance, capability, process, isolation, or authority invariants.
primary_question: Does the frozen DSH treatment achieve correctness at least as good as the native baseline while requiring no more human corrective intervention and without violating any frozen hard gate?
negative_result_semantics: A negative result is a successful experiment and does not authorize rescue, rerun, runtime implementation, or downstream action.

historical_fixture.base_semantics: Both arms begin from a fresh workspace at the exact BASE commit and receive only task_contract.json plus its declared input artifacts.

answer_key_firewall.scorer_release_condition: Only after the arm has terminated and its receipt is sealed.

dsh_upstream_identity.source_identity_evidence: Official repository README, official release page, and read-only git ls-remote/static source inspection.

causal_contrast_class.interpretation_ceiling: The result may answer whether this configured DSH system outperforms the current native system; it may not claim that the harness substrate alone caused an improvement.
unavoidable_differences: native controller is the repository-native Codex execution process while DSH controller is the pinned DeepSeek Harness process
native tool calls use the Codex shell/read/apply_patch surface while DSH uses its pinned plugin/tool surface
DSH may impose different internal context, scheduling, persistence, or protocol behavior even when the external role and retry budgets are matched
the DSH package is an external TypeScript/npm system and the native baseline is the current repository-native process

model_identities.reasoning_or_compute_setting: provider_default_frozen_at_model_id; receipt must capture resolved setting; missing resolution fails closed
model_identities.context_limit: provider_model_contract_for_gpt-5; receipt must capture resolved limit
model_identities.network_policy: model-provider API transport only as separately frozen below

retry_policy.crash_policy: terminate arm and fail closed after bounded restart ceiling
retry_policy.partial_completion_policy: score only frozen completed propositions; missing required evidence fails closed

native_arm.process_model: One controller-owned bounded task process with distinct builder, hostile reviewer, and verifier role identities; IMPLEMENT -> TEST -> one independent hostile review -> repair Critical/High -> at most one targeted rereview iff C/H repair occurred -> freeze.
native_arm.workspace_model: Fresh disposable QntyLab workspace at BASE SHA, no shared mutable checkout or cross-arm state.

retry_policy.internal_retry_visibility: Every internal DSH retry must emit a receipt event and consume the same machine retry ceiling.
retry_policy.crash_policy: terminate arm and fail closed after bounded restart ceiling
retry_policy.partial_completion_policy: score only frozen completed propositions; missing required evidence fails closed

dsh_arm.process_model: Pinned DSH controller with the same bounded role pipeline and no hidden unlimited internal retry or recursive review loop.
dsh_arm.workspace_model: Fresh disposable QntyLab workspace at BASE SHA, no shared mutable checkout or cross-arm state.

retry_and_failure_accounting.timeout_policy: 2700 seconds wall clock per arm; timeout is terminal FAIL_CLOSED
retry_and_failure_accounting.crash_policy: one bounded restart ceiling then terminal FAIL_CLOSED
retry_and_failure_accounting.partial_completion_policy: no required evidence or proposition may be inferred; missing evidence fails closed

isolation.workspace_isolation: Each arm gets a fresh disposable workspace created from BASE SHA; branch reuse and shared mutable checkouts are forbidden.
isolation.process_isolation: Each arm has an owned process tree and separate environment, trace, dispatch ledger, and scratch directory.
isolation.caches: Disabled where possible; any unavoidable package/model cache must be read-only, pre-provisioned before arm start, identical across arms, and content-addressed. No task/result/session cache is allowed.
isolation.answer_key_access: NONE for workers; post-termination scorer only

git_and_github_boundary.local_commits: DISALLOWED unless a separately authorized execution contract proves the historical task requires them; a local commit cannot publish remotely.

network_policy.dsh: MODEL_API_ONLY plus pinned-source bytes already provisioned outside the arm; no arbitrary tool egress
network_policy.network_mismatch_behavior: Any extra host or egress fails closed and is recorded as a hard-gate violation.

review_independence.completion_doctrine: IMPLEMENT -> TEST -> ONE independent hostile review -> repair Critical/High -> at most ONE targeted rereview iff C/H repair occurred -> freeze

arm_execution_order.rule: Compute SHA256('STAGE_A_DSH_SHADOW_EVALUATION_V0:' + arm_id) and execute ascending digest order; arm one cannot alter arm two.

tie_policy.stage_a_noninferiority: PASS only when all hard gates pass, DSH_CORRECTNESS >= NATIVE_BASELINE, and DSH_HUMAN_INTERVENTION <= NATIVE_BASELINE.
tie_policy.stage_a_fail: FAIL if any hard gate fails, DSH_CORRECTNESS < NATIVE_BASELINE, or DSH_HUMAN_INTERVENTION > NATIVE_BASELINE.
tie_policy.pass_no_incremental_value: If all hard gates pass and both primary dimensions are exact ties with no preregistered strict operational advantage, classify STAGE_A_PASS_NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE.
tie_policy.pass_with_incremental_value: Only if all original hard gates pass and at least one preregistered useful diagnostic is strictly better without regression in correctness or human intervention; diagnostics remain non-authoritative.
tie_policy.runtime_escalation: Neither PASS_NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE nor PASS_WITH_INCREMENTAL_VALUE authorizes runtime work. Any runtime implementation requires a separate Git-backed authorization phase.
